name: Ab Crunch Machine
steps: Choose a light weight and sit with your back against the pad.
Hook your feet under the foot pads and hold the handles.
Breathe out and curl your chest toward your knees.
Pause briefly, then return slowly without letting the weights touch.
cues: Curl the spine, not the arms

common_mistakes.fix: Keep the arms still and curl from the stomach
Go lighter and slow every rep down
Stop just before the weights touch
